verdict.rationale: Vercel AI Gateway is developer infrastructure (API routing/failover/billing for LLM providers) that is configured via code, dashboard, and API calls — not an interactive assistant meant to be 'operated' via natural-language commands. Evidence about coding-agent connectivity and ToolLoopAgent describes building agents that use the gateway, not commanding the gateway itself in natural language, so this axis is a category mismatch for this product type.
